experimentalModel.description: The {@link ReliabilityMlModelExperiment#experimentalModel} that was used to generate the data.

seriesData.description:
Contains all the {@link Timeseries} build from the primary model outputs inference.

@see MlModel#process

baseModelAlertsData.description:
Map where the key represents the name of the output and the value is a list of alerts build from the base model outputs.
This field is structured the same way as {@link #alertsData}, but contains alerts from the base model.

hyperparameterOverrides.description:
The hyperparameter overrides used for the experiment model.
This is needed to display the hyperparameters in the Update Model Parameters Form,
when multiple models are being tuned.

originalTrainingValidationPeriods.description: Stores the original training and validation periods for the given base modelId.
